'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matthew Gountis LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Gountis]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Matt Gountis
* '''Deck name:''' Watch Your Step
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
